1036typedef struct QDMI_PROGRAM_FORMAT_T {
1037 uint32_t version;
1038 uint32_t encoding;
1039 char id[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1040 char profile[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1041} QDMI_Program_Format;
1042
1043#ifdef __cplusplus
1044static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U);
1045static_assert(alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U);
1046static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U);
1047static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U);
1048static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U);
1049static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U);
1050#else
1051_Static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U,
1052 "QDMI_Program_Format must be 136 bytes");
1053_Static_assert(_Alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U,
1054 "QDMI_Program_Format must have four-byte alignment");
1055_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U,
1056 "QDMI_Program_Format.version must start at byte 0");
1057_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U,
1058 "QDMI_Program_Format.encoding must start at byte 4");
1059_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U,
1060 "QDMI_Program_Format.id must start at byte 8");
1061_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U,
1062 "QDMI_Program_Format.profile must start at byte 72");
1063#endif
1064
1071static inline int
1072QDMI_program_format_equal(const QDMI_Program_Format *const lhs,
1073 const QDMI_Program_Format *const rhs) {
1074 if (lhs == NULL || rhs == NULL || lhs->version != rhs->version ||
1075 lhs->encoding != rhs->encoding) {
1076 return 0;
1077 }
1078 for (size_t index = 0U; index < QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE; ++index) {
1079 if (lhs->id[index] != rhs->id[index] ||
1080 lhs->profile[index] != rhs->profile[index]) {
1081 return 0;
1082 }
1083 }
1084 return 1;
1085}
